name: Jean le Rond d'Alembert
summary: 18th-century French mathematician and scientist who submitted work to the Académie des sciences.

name: Paris
summary: Capital city of France, birthplace of d'Alembert.

name: Académie des sciences
summary: French scientific academy where d'Alembert submitted work in 1739.

name: Louis Camus Destouches
summary: Lieutenant general of French artillery who acted as d'Alembert's guardian.

name: Mme Destouches
summary: Member of the Camus-Destouches family with whom d'Alembert maintained contact.

name: Jean-Paul De Gua
summary: Mathematician related to the Camus-Destouches family who suggested d'Alembert's name adoption.

name: Leopold Philippe Charles Joseph d'Arenberg
summary: Duke of Arenberg, potential candidate for d'Alembert's biological father.

name: Mme Voituret
summary: Eldest daughter of d'Alembert's wet-nurse, mentioned in his will.
